votes.refutation: I checked global task configuration, local durable state, normal retries, and source-save/webhook recovery. Explicit retries require the executing code to catch an exception; they cannot run after process loss. The existing-head recovery at tasks.py:1211-1214 needs both another delivery and a committed run, neither of which exists in this window. Status saves do not refire the receiver (review_hog/backend/receivers.py:85-89), and opened bot-draft events deliberately do not use the re-review carve-out (tasks.py:160-169). The repository already uses both late acknowledgment and reject_on_worker_lost to protect task execution against process loss (posthog/tasks/tasks.py:348-358; usage_report.py:109-115). A real manual Inbox signal implementation can trigger this initial path, so worker loss produces a narrow missed review with manual refire as a workaround.
